description: This file defines the ModelEntity class, which models an entity in the OFBiz framework. It includes details such as entity name, table name, fields, relations, indexes, and related metadata. The class also provides methods for managing entity fields, relations, indexes, and various utility functions for entity definitions.

classes.name: ModelEntity
classes.description: Represents an entity in the OFBiz framework, encapsulating entity metadata, fields, relations, indexes, and configuration options. Provides methods for managing and retrieving entity information, including field manipulation, relation handling, index management, and utility functions for generating SQL and code representations.

methods.name: populateBasicInfo
methods.description: Populates basic entity information such as entity name, table name, package, dependency, locking, and cache settings from an XML element.

methods.name: addExtendEntity
methods.description: Extends an existing entity definition with additional XML configurations, potentially overriding existing fields and adding new relations or indexes.

methods.name: getEntityName
methods.description: Returns the name of the entity.

methods.name: setEntityName
methods.description: Sets the name of the entity.

methods.name: getTableName
methods.description: Returns the table name, optionally including schema based on datasource info.

methods.name: getFieldsUnmodifiable
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable list of the entity's fields.
